description: Player-side inputs of a real 125-turn UK student life session played on a plain chat setup. Use as a token benchmark and recall checklist. Model replies on replay will differ from the original.

Inspect my room

Put my phone on charge, check the notifications
Check out the window
Reply in the whatsapp group thanking dai, tell everyone ill be sorting the garden out does anyone want to help me

Have a shower and get dressed making me look good then leave the room, where am I
Follow the smell of toast

Ask if she's a jam or just a butter gal
Ask if she wants a brew doing
Make the tea but check her out
Ask her what she is studying again and make myself a coffee

Ask her if we have any garden gloves

Swat him the 80p loose change i have in my pocket in the jar

Polish it off and go to coop as I leave say to the lad sorry I didn't catch you name
Get the milk for cerys and get a four pack of beer
Hand her my driving licence, check her out as she checks the license

Ask Marcus how we should tackle it and let him know of the bags of brambles

Say cheers and introduce Marcus to her, mention if she needs anything just shout up, but say it in a way that nothings free
A tenner, im not sure its worth our time especially with studying glenys but I'll keep it in mind

Go check what clothes I can wear for tonight, stylish for a night out but utility if I need it

Ask if she's alright and brush her cheek
